articles.summary: BOSTON , July 24, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Boston Beer Company, Inc. (NYSE: SAM), today reported financial results for the second quarter ended June 28, 2025 . Key results were: Second Quarter 2025 Summary: Depletions decreased 5% and shipments decreased 0.8% Net revenue of $587.9 million
